the curriculum should be based on the development of emotional competences and the strengthening of the intelligence emotional in the students.

, the emotional intelligence is a set of personal and social abilities that allow us to understand, manage, and express emotions in an effective way, which is a very important skill for our daily activities.

the curriculum should include a proposal to develop the emotional intelligence of students.
the TMMS-24 and the self-reported measure of emotional intelligence are not interchangeable measures.
